title: HoloScript GPU bench receipt v2
description: Unified bench-receipt shape for GPU/CPU-substitute captures across the paper program. Every paper bench artifact SHOULD emit this shape so reviewers can immediately tell which execution path produced a number — the path field is the camera-ready honesty knob.

receipt_version.description: Schema version. v1 = pre-2026-05-29 ad-hoc shape; v2 = this schema.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at the moment the harness emitted the receipt.

path.description: The execution path that produced these numbers. webgpu-browser = real WebGPU in a real browser (Playwright + Chromium with navigator.gpu adapter). cpu-component = a CPU baseline for related primitives that is not algorithmically equivalent to the GPU kernel. cpu-substitute = a deterministic CPU implementation of the same algorithm. cuda-native = libcuda/CUDA C++. wasm-simd = WASM SIMD path. wgpu-native = wgpu Rust binding native build.

paper.description: Stable paper identifier matching the audit-matrix row (e.g. paper-4-sandbox-usenix, trust-by-construction-paper, paper-2-snn-neurips).

section.description: Optional section reference within the paper (e.g. '7.8', '5.1', 'Table III').

harness.description: Repo-relative path to the test/script that produced this receipt.

adapter_info.description: navigator.gpu.requestAdapterInfo() result for webgpu-browser path; null for non-GPU paths.

kernel.description: Identifies the exact compute kernel that ran. The wgsl_sha256 field lets a reviewer cryptographically verify the same shader source bytes were dispatched.

wgsl_path.description: Repo-relative path to the .wgsl source file, or null for a non-WGSL path.

wgsl_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the WGSL source bytes (UTF-8), or null for a non-WGSL path.

protocol_commit.description: Git SHA of the harness/protocol doc at capture time. Lets a reviewer pin the receipt to a specific protocol version.

code_provenance.description: Content-addressed identity for the executable evidence path. relevant_paths_clean is scoped to the listed inputs, not the whole repository.

ots_proof_path.description: Path to the OpenTimestamps .ots sidecar that anchors this receipt to Bitcoin. Produced by a follow-up sign step; null if not yet anchored.

anchor_chain.description: On-chain anchor identifier (e.g. 'base-mainnet:0x...' or 'base-sepolia:0x...'). Null if not yet anchored.
